Class HouseService

java.lang.Object
org.app.services.HouseService
public class HouseService extends Object
The HouseService class provides service methods to manage House entities.

This class handles database operations such as retrieving all houses, retrieving a house by its key, and inserting new houses into the database using JPA's EntityManager.

Key Features:

  • Handles the lifecycle of EntityManager and performs transactions for house entities.
  • Supports eager fetching of related characters using a JOIN FETCH query.
  • Logs key actions, such as retrieval and insertion of houses, using the Logger from Log4j2.

  • Method Details

    • getAllHouses

      public List<House> getAllHouses()
      Retrieves all houses from the database with their associated characters eagerly fetched.

      This method uses a JPQL query with LEFT JOIN FETCH to retrieve houses along with their characters in a single query, reducing the need for multiple database calls.

      Returns:
      A list of all houses with their characters eagerly fetched, or null if an error occurs.

    • getHouseByHouseKey

      public House getHouseByHouseKey(String houseKey)
      Retrieves a house from the database by its unique house key.

      This method uses a JPQL query to find the house based on its houseKey.

      Parameters:
      houseKey - The unique key of the house to be retrieved.
      Returns:
      The house with the given key, or null if no such house is found or if an error occurs.

    • insertHouse

      public void insertHouse(House newHouse)
      Inserts a new house into the database.

      This method opens a transaction, persists the new House entity, and commits the transaction. If any error occurs, the transaction is rolled back.

      Parameters:
      newHouse - The House entity to be inserted into the database.

    • close

      public void close()
      Closes the EntityManagerFactory when no longer needed.

      This method ensures that the EntityManagerFactory is properly closed to release any resources held by the persistence unit.
